costly recalls, or threaten regulatory compliance. These industries demand solutions built for
precision, consistency, and durability.

[Prevent These Common Industrial Die Cutting Mistakes][141]

Industrial die cutting demands high precision, yet mistakes like incomplete cuts, rough edges, and
improper creasing frequently cause costly waste and assembly delays. To prevent these errors,
manufacturers must perform proactive test cuts on challenging soft or thick materials, select the
right pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) paired with tear-resistant film liners, and balance design
tolerances to match material flexibility. Furthermore, regular preventive equipment
maintenance—including blade sharpening and alignment calibration—combined with modern automation
tools ensures consistent pressure, drastically minimizing defects while driving efficient,
sustainable, and high-quality production runs.

## Built to Perform.
## Engineered for Tough Conditions.

Adherex works with OEMs to create specialty materials that endure heat, vibration, sterilization,
and harsh environments. Every adhesive, foam part, and protective package is precision-engineered
and rigorously tested to ensure reliable performance under pressure.

**Meeting the Demands of OEMs.** In OEM markets, even a minor material failure can have major
consequences. A weak adhesive, miscut foam, or inconsistent packaging can halt production, trigger
costly recalls, or threaten regulatory compliance. These industries demand solutions built for
precision, consistency, and durability.

# Product Development. Technical Expertise. Value-Added Capabilities.

### Our Capabilities

Combining engineering expertise with advanced processes like water jet and rotary die-cutting, we
help OEMs overcome design limits and scale seamlessly from prototype to production.

[Capabilities][62]

### 5-Axis Water Jet Cutting

Adherex provides protective packaging designed to exact part specifications. Whether it’s foam
inserts, corrugated plastic dividers, or custom totes with dunnage, each solution balances
durability, cost, and efficiency.

[Protective Packaging][63]
[Silicone Tapes Products]

### Slitting & Rewinding

From double-sided and silicone tapes to BSR and tabbing tapes, our solutions are custom-designed,
rigorously tested, and delivered with the reliability OEMs need to keep production moving.

[Specialty Tapes][64]

# Most Recognized Brand Offerings

[SpecBond Logo]
[Cutting Edge Logo]

**As a 3M™ Associate and Preferred Automotive Converter**, Adherex Specialty Materials combines
direct access to 3M’s high-performance tapes, adhesives, and specialty materials with our precision
converting expertise, ensuring custom solutions that meet the highest standards of performance,
consistency, and reliability.

**As a member of the GFA**, Adherex leverages shared expertise in materials science, converting
technology, and fabrication best practices to engineer precision gaskets that deliver superior
sealing performance, dimensional stability, and reliability across industrial, automotive,
electronic, and medical applications.

**Being an ISO-certified company** means Adherex operates under a rigorously audited quality
management system that ensures consistency, traceability, and reliability in every product and
process.

compromise the other. Partnering with a material specialist like Adherex early in the design and
prototyping process helps companies overcome this challenge. **We work with engineers, packaging

Industrial die cutting demands high precision, yet mistakes like incomplete cuts, rough edges, and
improper creasing frequently cause costly waste and assembly delays. To prevent these errors,
manufacturers must perform proactive test cuts on challenging soft or thick materials, select the
right pressure-sensitive adhesives (PSAs) paired with tear-resistant film liners, and balance design
tolerances to match material flexibility. Furthermore, regular preventive equipment
maintenance—including blade sharpening and alignment calibration—combined with modern automation
tools ensures consistent pressure, drastically minimizing defects while driving efficient,
sustainable, and high-quality production runs.
